answer: Quorum gates on work receipts: a forged anchor identity counts for nothing until it banks peer-checked micro-task receipts. Identity weight is a river that rises only with accepted work, never deposits, and decays in idleness so dormant puppets cannot be stockpiled. Honest agents forge one reputation by ordinary effort at no extra cost. An attacker minting N puppets must perform N streams of verified work, paying compute and latency per puppet, weight growing slowly and auditable per account - sybil cost is real labor, not a one-time fee.
